programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who's swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Monkey Island
programme.desc: Tensions rise when drought overtakes an ancient Sri Lankan temple shared by tufted grey langurs, toque macaques, and purple-faced leaf monkeys. Witness the drama as the lower-ranking primates struggle to stay hydrated amid a mutinous plot.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher's pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Shadowlands
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world - the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who's swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: Strange Creatures
programme.desc: Dive into the lives of the ocean's weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fish's eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She's the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she's looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda's unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call \.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: It's November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: For the second leg of his African adventure, Clive has arrived in Ghana. Sometimes called West Africa's 'golden child', the country is known for its deep history, miles of glittering beaches and rich culture. Clive’s first stop is the beachside capital of Accra, home to over two million people. It’s packed with vibrant art, bustling traditional markets and high-rise modernity. He heads to one of the world’s biggest second-hand markets to meet the designers giving discarded clothes a second chance. Inspired by his dressmaker mum, Clive tries a bit of sewing for himself. Once he’s kitted out with a great new look, he heads to the studio of Dancegod Lloyd to learn some moves from the man who turned traditional dance moves into viral hits and who starred in a Beyoncé video. Clive also picks up his paint brush to learn more about the unusual art of fantasy coffins, and he compares his mum’s Jamaican smoked fish with Ghana’s best as he meets the young chefs determined to turn Ghanaian cuisin.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Xishuangbanna Part 2
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get.

programme.desc: The city of Kolkata is one of the most densely populated in the world. That’s a lot of mouths to feed. Fortunately, it’s a place that knows just how to do it. Fuelled by the bustling energy of street vendors, Will seeks inspiration from Indian working man's essentials.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "The Original Fast Food

programme.desc: In this program we’ll get an insight of the importance of quality, as Antonin sources his ingredients with diligence. Making careful use of all elements, his kitchen manages to match sustainability with elegance and excellence.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Clément Bouvier – Ursus
programme.desc: In his quest to amaze his guests, Clément aims to always surprise, always exceed their expectations. By bringing the very forest to the table, both in his cuisine and in architecture, his visitors are in for a special and unique treat.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?
programme.sub-title: Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?
programme.desc: In the land of tequila, Liesel gets the skinny on the premium export of Jalisco, blue agave tequila. From harvesting agave with the legendary jimadores, to understanding the process of distillation, Liesel is on the hunt to appreciate and understand the production requirements of this spirit that makes it what it is. Are they worth it only if they’re from Jalisco or can they be made somewhere else for cheaper and better..? Liesel finds out.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Los Angeles: Food trucks: are they any good?
programme.sub-title: Los Angeles: Food trucks: are they any good?
programme.desc: It’s a well known fact that Los Angeles is the trendsetter for entertainment, fashion, and outlandish celebrity exploits. But is it the same story with the food? Liesel explores the food truck bubble to figure out what started the craze, why it's so popular, and more importantly, is the food any good.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Costa Rica
programme.desc: Marilia explores Costa Rica, connecting with nature at Zunya, experiences a cacao ceremony with the Maleku Tribe, and finds wellness in Tamarindo's Cala Luna. At La Senda, she learns to appreciate nature's beauty and the importance of slowing down.

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Caiscais & Uga Bay

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Bangkok & Barbados
programme.desc: This episode is all about food, from tasting some of the best and most expensive street food in Bangkok to one of the world’s best placed restaurants in Barbados, it’s a food lover’s dream.

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Barcelona & St Lucia

programme.desc: Blenheim schoolteachers Joanna and Chris begin a rollercoaster ride to home ownership and in South Auckland, locals Shandel and Steven take on the investors in their quest to secure a family home.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "The City and the Country
programme.desc: City boy Ethan Tey gears up for an Auckland auction and in Blenheim will Joanna and Chris stop fighting long enough to buy their first home.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Mediterranean Scuba

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "The Boss
programme.desc: An expat adjusts to working with her husband after 34 years of teaching. A scuba business considers relocating to the UK. Bar owners in Spain's desert face their busiest night.

programme.desc: In his toughest challenge so far, Ash takes on Eagle’s Neck – a notoriously steep and dangerous section of the Great Wall of China. But first, he meets tech experts who’ve been helping to digitally map The Great Wall in an effort to protect it.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He’s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Desert Survival
programme.desc: Ash heads into the desert to meet up with Wu Xinlei, who is a survival expert. He’s hoping to understand what it would have been like for the people who built The Great Wall in this remote and punishing landscape.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "Greater ft Lauderdale

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "St. Thomas and St. Croix

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Sweet Country Home

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "A Smart Decision
programme.desc: Darlene and Bruce are in the market for a new home and have enlisted Laura to help them out. Darlene's one request is that they stay close to their current home, where their daughter goes to school.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Pool House
programme.desc: Kathryn and Neil are true urbanites. They love what downtown Toronto has to offer. When Neil found out his company was relocating to Guelph, they weren’t thrilled. After five months of long commutes, the Thompson family is ready to take the risk and make a move—with some conditions. The new house has to have a pool and playroom for the kids and a large entertainment area for adults. Eve’s challenge is to find them an enticing home that will convince their friends from the city to visit.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Incredible Conversions
programme.desc: Converting old buildings like warehouses and churches into modern homes is not for the faint hearted. Discover some truly amazing conversions that manage to successfully combine modern design without elminating the original charm of the old buildings - and the results are spectacular.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Antarctica
programme.desc: Jonathan caps off the season with an expedition into the spirit of isolation; a journey that takes him from Arunchal pradesh, India, to Dolomites in Italy, to all the way down in Antarctica.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Season 3 Special
programme.desc: All the highs and lows of our beast of a third season; recounted by Jonathan as he shows the audience deleted scenes and gives them insider information on how the episodes came together.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - "Adelaide

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tokyo

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nikko

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Re-live
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave re-live some more of the highlights from their incredible 6000km journey.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Otago
programme.desc: Piri is in the Otago region. Crutching merino sheep, hunting wild bull, deer stalking and trout fishing.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Prince Edward Island

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Panama

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Gabon

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Finland
programme.desc: Jonathan is in on a quest to uncover the Finnish psyche. What gives them their ultra calm demeanor? Murder mysteries, taxidermy centers, Argentinian tango to rally driving.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Ireland
programme.desc: A nation of gregarious people that loves their libations; a fantastic whiskey tasting at Teeling in Dublin makes Jonathan wonder, what happened to Irish whiskey? How did it lose the crown to Scotland? To find out, he gets an adventure bike and charts course on a new mission to find out.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Russia
programme.desc: Russia, the nation of czars! Jonathan bounces around opulent subway networks, chances upon Russia's legendary space exploration initiative, heads to Grozny for gritty hands on combat, and so much more.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Estonia / Vietnam
programme.desc: In this episode, Josh travels to Tallinn in Estonia with urban explorer Steve Duncan where they explore Patarei Prison. Meanwhile, Cody is in Vietnam with his friend Sherman Mak and travels to Pan Thiet in search of abandoned amusement park Soui Cat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Germany / Morocco
programme.desc: This time urban explorers Josh and Cody separately visit Germany and Morocco in search of astonishing abandoned locations including Wünsdorf, the forbidden city near Berlin, and an abandoned filmset in the Sahara desert used for Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Georgia / France
programme.desc: Josh and Cody are separately visiting Georgia and France. Cody, together with rooftopper Harry Gallagher, undertakes a cable car trip known as 'Stalin’s coffin'. Josh is in France searching for abandoned chateaus with globetrotter Lexie Limitless.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "California
programme.desc: Eric Hanson laces up his hiking boots to explore some of California’s most iconic wilderness, including Yosemite National Park, the Mojave Desert and Butte County.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Poland
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to Poland to explore the breathtaking trails of the Tatra and Pieniny mountain ranges.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Revelstoke
programme.desc: Eric Hanson explores the incredible backpacking trails that surround one of the most adventurous mountain towns in North America - Revelstoke, British Columbia.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Kapiti
programme.desc: Piri is in Kapiti to fish for tuna, spearfishing and get some insight on native birds in the area.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - "Great Barrier Island
programme.desc: Piri heads to Aotea on the Great Barrier Island with the Blackwell family. Join in as Piri dives for seafood and hunts for pigs.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - "Ruapeke Island
programme.desc: Tangaroa and Rory take Piri hunting for deer, in search of shellfish in a lagoon and diving for Jurassic size seafood.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Ohrigstad to Pilgrims Rest
programme.desc: From the Echo Caves of South Africa to the historical Pilgrims Rest, Xander begins to feel at home again in the location where he grew up.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Winelands of the Cape
programme.desc: While Xander and his team enjoy good food and wine at the family owned Spier Wine Farm, Adam spends his day making cider and looking through his family’s belongings.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Grabouw to Botriver
programme.desc: A wine farm surrounded by mountains, a day of hiking and picnics, and delectable food paired with premium wine is on the itinerary for Xander and his team as they make their way from Grabouw to Botrivier.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "The Honeymoon is Over
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason take on their final peak in Washington State, Mt Baker. Tayler struggles when Jason explains all the things that could go wrong, but the reality is a lot could fail if they don't come together as a team.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Arizona
programme.desc: Classic Western scenery; vast moonscape-like red terrain, this is the land of cowboys! With a fully outfitted 4x4 and a whisper silent electric bike, Jonathan is dead set on finding the Lost Dutchman’s mine.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Serbia
programme.desc: Jonathan is on a mission to trace the Danube river; the same path taken by his immigrant ancestors from Germany. His journey starts underneath the massive Kalemegdan fortress,to uncover Atilla the Hun’s supposed grave. It continues on, to unearth a story on the theme of welcoming immigrants; the Middle Eastern refugees.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Hong Kong
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is in Asia’s world city, Hong Kong! With all things opulent and luxurious; high end art collectors to the priciest wines in the world, super car aficionados and helicopter getaways from skyscraper rooftops; this is the road less traveled from a different point of view.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Bondi Backyard
programme.desc: Chris visits China and explores a masterpiece of history , is shadowed by giants on Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, takes on a photo challenge in his own Bondi backyard, and joins a safari to a coastal community, well off the grid.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Natural Magic
programme.desc: Chris takes on one of the world’s most amazing cities, in search of the old and the new, meets an island local that makes everyone smile, and is on the trail of the elusive Aussie platypus.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Huangshan Part 1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the regions's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Huangshan Part 2
programme.desc: The hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Indonesia - Balinese cuisine: what is it all about?
programme.sub-title: Indonesia - Balinese cuisine: what is it all about?
programme.desc: Balinese cuisine is considered to be extremely complex. Different than what you find in the rest of Indonesia, Bali is further influenced by the major influx of Western tourism. Have the locals kept their traditions and cooking methods strong against the wave of tourism, or have they been catered to suit the palates of foreigners? Liesel heads to the ultimate getaway paradise island, sifts through all the yoga retreats, surfer shacks, and coffee plantations all in an effort to find iconic food - as well as track down the current foodie trend of the island.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Ireland - Dublin, what else is there besides the pub culture
programme.sub-title: Ireland - Dublin, what else is there besides the pub culture
programme.desc: Admit it, first thing you relate with Dublin are the pubs. Sure, they are a staple and they serve some of the best brews in the world. And they come with an associated culture that is hard to rival. But what about the food? Does Dublin have a burgeoning foodie scene or is it all about the pint o’ Guiness? Find out on this episode of Max Foodie as Liesel explores the breathtakingly beautiful country of Ireland.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Bali
programme.desc: Bali, the paradise island of magic. It's about progression at Motion Skate Park, DIY at the Jungle spot, vegan indulgence at Kynd café, design for the Hand of God, hot bowl grinds at the Dog Bowl and Loco by Nature and Televisi Star worldwide.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Milan
programme.desc: 120 Hours in Milan where dreams come true. Connect at Rufus Skate and textured expressions. The global community at Milano Centrale. Candy Coast, try and try again for creative escape. Flying at Lambrate Skate Park, photographic genius and unity.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Ireland
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Bali
programme.desc: Marilia's Bali journey, focused on purification rituals, blended culture, healing, and adventure. From Tirta Empul's cleansing to exploring Ubud, embracing nature, and local traditions, she found serenity, capturing precious moments in her odyssey.

programme.title: Travel in Style S4 - "Finolhu and Banff
programme.desc: From the Maldives to Canada, this episode explores the very best on offer for a sunny get away on a resort, to a snowy retreat in the mountains.

programme.title: Travel in Style S4 - "Malaysia and L.A.
programme.desc: From Asia to America, we explore the different cultures of Malaysia and Los Angeles, and the benefits of visiting both. One teaches us to relax, while the other encourages us to go all out.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Jackfruit
programme.desc: In Bali's lush landscapes, Lauren explores the tropical origin of jackfruit, partnering with a Balinese chef to unveil age-old recipes and techniques, showcasing how this versatile fruit reigns supreme in traditional and modern dishes.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - "Mascot Magic
programme.desc: Rhys learns the tricks of the trade from Japan's #1 mascot, battles a roboticist, experiences the relaxation of forest bathing, and trains with a samurai master.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - "Finding Family
programme.desc: Rhys doubles his efforts to break into the Japanese entertainment industry by getting a brand designed, and by enrolling in mascot school. Missing his family, he spends time with a Japanese family who are a little bit like the Osbournes.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - "The Masters
programme.desc: Rhys learns what makes Japanese audiences tick from a pair of comedy masters, and he puts on a comedy show of his own. Also, New Zealand's mascot Pabu-chan is finally revealed to the world.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Family Values
programme.desc: A new generation of female chargers band together to compete in a unique big wave surfing ‘expression session’ on the north shore of Oahu.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Skullbase
programme.desc: The Walsh twins reveal why water safety crews and rescue teams are the unsung heroes of big wave surfing.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Impact Zone
programme.desc: Francisco Porcella displays the unquenchable spirit that drives the desire to chase big waves.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Quebec
programme.desc: Michael explores a Quebecois island by ferry, joins the Canadian Coast Guard behind the scenes, and visits a museum to see the future of rail.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Ontario
programme.desc: Michael explores southern Ontario, tries flying a helicopter, and joins an Indigenous festival before a 36-hour ride on the iconic Canadian.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Manitoba
programme.desc: Michael eats and explores his way through Winnipeg, tries curling, and takes a road trip that ends at a relaxing outdoor spa.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Switzerland
programme.desc: Lugano, home of Morel, Oops Bar and The Warriors. To Basel for cheesy potatoes, DIY with Oli and Claudia, Pipoz, Portland Bowl, the president, creative concrete and wood and the Rock n' Rollers. Back to The Beast then love underground at Bern Moosweg.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Berlin
programme.desc: Berlin beautiful grunge, skate spoons, freestyle analogue,Griefswalder DIY and Skatesencia. Sketistan HQ, positive impact for kids the world over, NBU home of Hera, a space for expression. Place magazine, potato pants album cover prints and Templehof.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "New York
programme.desc: Yann Horowitz delves into NYC's skate scene, visiting shops, meeting legends, and exploring iconic spots. He highlights skateboarding's community and inclusivity, expressing affection for the city and the connections forged through his passion.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "London
programme.desc: James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "United Kingdom
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England - proving the rest of England is more accessible than one might think.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Desert
programme.desc: Lisa connects with a nomad poet, who literally helps her ‘climb’ out of her funk by scaling a challenging peak. After taking tea with a magician, Lisa meets a paramedic single mother hoping to imbue her daughter with valuable life experiences.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Coast
programme.desc: After driving across the country, Lisa heads to Santa Monica to hang with a Hollywood producer and check out his pimped out Mercedes Benz G-Wagon. Lisa is welcomed into the school bus home of a family of 7! Because there is always room for one more.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Lisbon
programme.desc: Two street artists are fusing their styles together in one of the world's finest cities, Lisbon.The challenge is left hanging by a thread when disaster strikes.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "London
programme.desc: Two legendary street artists team up in London for the ultimate Street Art Challenge. Things get out of hand between the two as it turns into a street fight.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Brooklyn
programme.desc: Yann Horowitz skateboards with the KCDC skateboarding community in Brooklyn. Where he explores gaming, art and grilling with Crossy, Natalie, Jacob, Eddie and Nate, culminating in a joyful skate event showcasing community, inclusivity and fun.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "New Jersey
programme.desc: Yann delves into New Jersey's skateboarding culture, meeting skateboarders who are into, fashion, horror, comedy, tattooing, and rug-making. He explores NJ Skate Shop and Freedom Skate Park, encountering Fred Gall and Brian Anderson.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Philadelphia
programme.desc: Yann immerses himself in Philadelphia's skateboarding culture. He explores Nocturnal Skate Shop eats a Philly cheesesteak, visits Cloud 9 pottery studio, admires Adam's art collection, skates with Celina, and experiences the creativity of FDR.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "London
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx steps outside of her comfort zone to draw inspiration for her music track from urban youths in London’s Grime scene.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Amsterdam
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx travels to Amsterdam to influence her music track and discovers it’s a whole lot more experimental than she imagined.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Love The Location
programme.desc: Ashley and Ali are ready to take their relationship and living situation to the nest level.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Big Move
programme.desc: Stephanie is making a big move from BC to Guelph to be closer to her son John and his family. Eve will show Stephanie three beautiful homes that fit the criteria.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - "Mawera
programme.desc: In the Eastern Bay of Plenty,Mawera, Karla and Steve take Piri hunting for peacock and I get schooled in the art of MMA in a cage fight with a master.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - "Kuaotunu, Coromandel Peninsula
programme.desc: Champion spear fisherman, Julian, takes Piri spear fishing and into the bush chasing pigs.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Brazil…The Amazon
programme.desc: Seeing a jaguar in the wild is nearly impossible but working with one of the leading jaguar experts, Bill assists in a prey/predator study to get the best chance. In the process, he comes literally face to face with an 18 foot long Amazon Anaconda.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Antarctica
programme.desc: Violent oceans, giant icebergs and incredible scenery are all in a day’s work in the Southern Continent. Bill shadows penguin researchers as they take population counts of one of the most fascinating birds on earth.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Mexico
programme.desc: Jonathan begins his theme of exploration on all things the Spanish Conquistadores could not suppress.From the ancient bitter drink of Chocolatl, to the world’s fastest growing religion, Santa Muerte. Between delicious foods at taco stands to exploring bustling markets in Mexico City.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Mexico Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan's Mexico adventure takes a new turn; the continuous pumping of Mexico’s lakes has caused not only a water shortage, but a seismic issue. He pinballs around the vast city to gain an understanding into this complex issue.
